# 701.72. Assimilate (in 701. Keyword Actions)

<!-- Generated by scripts/fetch-rules.mjs from the Comprehensive Rules effective November 6, 2026. Do not edit. -->

701.72. Assimilate

701.72a To assimilate a permanent, gain control of it and put a +1/+1 counter on it. It becomes a Borg artifact creature.

701.72b To assimilate a permanent card that’s in a zone other than the battlefield, put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it. It’s a Borg artifact creature.

701.72c An object may have an ability printed on it that assimilates another object and another ability that refers to permanents “assimilated with [this object].” These abilities are linked; the second refers only to permanents that have been assimilated due to the first. See rule 607, “Linked Abilities.”
